---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea or enhancement for Life SMP
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: ['enhancement']
assignees: ''
---

### Feature Summary
A clear and concise description of the feature or enhancement you are proposing.

### Motivation / Use Case
What problem does this solve? Why would this feature be useful for players or server administrators?

### Proposed Behavior
Explain how this feature should work from both player and admin perspectives:
- Commands / Permissions needed (if any)
- Configuration options in `config.yml` / `config.json`
- Event interactions (e.g. PvP, death ban, regeneration)

### Alternatives Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you have considered.

### Additional Context
Add any other context, screenshots, or mockups about the feature request here.
